{{recipesummary|category=Mousse recipes|servings=6|time=15 minutes, start to finish!|difficulty=3}}
{{nutritionsummary|1 mousse (160 g)|6|609|438|48.7 g|31.2 g|42 mg|96 mg|36.4 g|0.8 g|35.7 g|3.1 g|4%|5%|11%|6%}}

'''Instant Chocolate Mousse''' is a dessert composed primarily of cocoa powder, coffee, and whipped cream. Unlike some other chocolate mousse recipes, this one does not require melted chocolate or eggs.

==Ingredients==

=== Mousse ===
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]/2.1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) unsweetened [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
* ¼ cup plus 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] (90 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]/3 fl oz) hot brewed [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 cups (500 ml/1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]]) [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* ⅔ cup ({{convert|80|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
* 1 oz (28 g) [[Cookbook:Kirsch|kirsch]] (cherry [[Cookbook:Brandy|brandy]]), chocolate brandy, or coffee liqueur

=== Plating ===
* 6 chocolate cups or shells
* Small [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate bar]] (for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]])
* 6 [[Cookbook:Cherry|maraschino cherries]]

==Procedure==

# In a medium bowl, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] together the cocoa powder, coffee, and salt. It should whisk easily and have the consistency of melted chocolate. If it is too thick, whisk in another tablespoon of coffee. Set aside.
# In a large bowl, use an [[Cookbook:Mixer|electric mixer]] on medium-high to [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] the cream for 1 minute.
# Add the powdered sugar and whip for another minute.
# Add the kirsch and coffee-cocoa powder mixture.
# Whip on high until stiff peaks form, about another minute.
# Spoon the mousse into a medium plastic bag or [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|piping bag]], and twist the top closed.
# Use scissors to snip off one corner (about ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] up).
# Arrange the chocolate cups on serving plates. If the cups don't sit flat, place a dollop of mousse under them.
# Squeeze the bag to pipe the mousse into the chocolate cups.
# Use a [[Cookbook:Vegetable Peeler|vegetable peeler]] to shave the chocolate bar over the mousse-filled cups, letting some of the shavings scatter on the plate.
# Top each mousse with a cherry.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Refrigerate if not eating immediately.
